summary: TASKEZY CRM Iteration-2 verified end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 new pytest cases pass (AI insights, leads POST + 422 validation, notifications list/unread-count/mark-one/mark-all/404, reports list+detail+404, campaigns list+detail+404+create with computed cpl/ctr/roas). Frontend: AI Insights renders 4 AI-generated cards (Gemini-3-flash via Emergent LLM key, NOT static fallback), bell on Dashboard opens /notifications with working 'Mark all as read', Leads FAB opens 'New Lead' sheet, form validation surfaces 'Name is required' / 'Phone is required', successful submit navigates to /lead/<id> and new lead is visible back in the Leads list. More tab → Reports (6 unique cards with KPIs), Team (8 agent cards with call+email actions), Campaigns (cards with Spend/CPL/ROAS and the newly-created TEST_Iter2 Campaign) all render correctly. Existing RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, transform-origin) are still present — already raised in iteration 1.

integration_issues.issue: First load of /api/dashboard/insights can take 60–180s because gemini-3-flash-preview is slow; the section just shows the 'AI Insights' heading with no skeleton/loader during that window. Functionally correct (4 AI items appear once response arrives), but UX feels stuck. Consider rendering the static fallback immediately and replacing with AI items when ready, or add a skeleton/spinner.

react_native_issues.issue: RN-web warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (and any inline shadow.* usages). Already reported in iteration 1; still present.

RN-web warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Search `pointerEvents=` in /app/frontend/src and move it into the style object. Already reported in iteration 1; still present.
RN-web error: 'Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`. Did you mean `transformOrigin`?'. Replace `transform-origin` with `transformOrigin` in styles. Already reported in iteration 1; still present.

action_items: (Optional UX) Show the static fallback or a skeleton/loader on the Dashboard 'AI Insights' section while /api/dashboard/insights is in-flight — gemini-3-flash-preview can take >60s.
Migrate shadow.* style props to RN boxShadow (carryover from iteration 1).
Move pointerEvents prop into style.pointerEvents (carryover from iteration 1).
Replace `transform-origin` with `transformOrigin` in styles (carryover from iteration 1).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1000 lines — strongly consider splitting into modular routers (auth/dashboard/leads/notifications/reports/campaigns); two @app.on_event('startup') handlers are defined which works but is fragile, consider consolidating into one startup function.
/api/dashboard/insights gracefully falls back to 3 static items if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is missing or the LLM call fails — correctly handled.
POST /api/leads returns 200 (not 201) on creation; spec usually expects 201, but tests accept 200. Consider standardising.
All new Mongo queries exclude _id via projection ({"_id": 0}) — no ObjectId serialisation leakage.

All new interactive UI elements carry testIDs: dashboard-notifications, notif-mark-all, notif-back, leads-new-fab, new-lead-{name,phone,email,source-*,interest-*,budget,notes,submit,close}, more-{reports,team,campaigns}, reports-back, report-<id>, report-download-<id>, team-back, team-call-<id>, team-email-<id>, campaigns-back.

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 new iter-2 tests; previous 25 from iter-1 still passing)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on iter-2 flows (dashboard insights, notifications, new-lead create+validation, /more/reports, /more/team, /more/campaigns)

rca_of_issue: No iteration-2 bugs found. AI Insights perceived-empty state RCA: gemini-3-flash-preview latency observed ~3 minutes in backend logs (LiteLLM completion start 06:41:42 → next call 06:44:58); the dashboard fetches insights without a loading placeholder, so users see only the section heading until response arrives — recommended mitigation: show static fallback immediately, then hot-swap when AI response lands (or add skeleton).
